name: Team
definition: A football club that participates in league matches and carries FIFA playing-style attributes.
scope: Team identity, playing-style analysis and match participation.

name: League
definition: A competition that groups the matches of one country and one season.
scope: League-level ranking and aggregation of matches.

name: Country
definition: The country that hosts a league.
scope: Association between a league and its host country.

name: Match
definition: A single played fixture between a home team and an away team inside a league and a season.
scope: Match-level facts: participating teams, season, goals.

name: Player
definition: A footballer registered in the database with identity and physique attributes.
scope: Player identity, physique and career-wide ability analysis.

name: Team Playing Style Profile
definition: A dated snapshot of a team's FIFA playing-style attributes covering build-up play, chance creation and defence.
scope: Team playing-style analysis at a stated snapshot date.

name: Player Ability Profile
definition: A dated snapshot of a player's FIFA ability attributes, including the overall rating, individual skill scores and work rates.
scope: Player ability analysis at a stated snapshot date.

name: Team Internal Identifier
definition: The database-internal team key that references a team from matches and from team playing-style profiles.
scope: Joining Match and Team_Attributes to Team.

name: Team FIFA Identifier
definition: The external FIFA identifier of a team, carried on both Team and Team_Attributes.
scope: Reporting or filtering teams by their FIFA identifier.

name: Team Long Name
definition: The full display name of a team.
scope: Human-readable team output.

name: Team Short Name
definition: The abbreviated three-letter display name of a team.
scope: Abbreviated team output; not unique across teams.

name: Player Internal Identifier
definition: The database-internal player key shared by Player, Player_Attributes and the player slots of Match.
scope: Joining player identity to ability profiles and to match appearances.

name: Player Name
definition: The full name of a player held in a single text field that contains both given name and surname.
scope: Identifying players in questions and output; not unique.

name: Player Birthday
definition: The recorded date of birth of a player, stored as a date-time value.
scope: Age and birth-cohort filtering of players.

name: Player Birth Year
definition: The calendar year component of a player's birthday, used for cohort statements such as being born before a given year or after a decade.
scope: Birth-cohort filtering of players.

name: Season
definition: The competition season label that groups matches, written as two consecutive calendar years separated by a slash.
scope: Temporal grouping of matches for league-level aggregation.

name: League Name
definition: The full name of a league, which already embeds the name of its host country.
scope: Identifying a league in questions and output.

name: Team Attribute Snapshot Date
definition: The date at which a team playing-style profile was captured.
scope: Selecting the correct team playing-style snapshot for a stated year or date.

name: Player Attribute Snapshot Date
definition: The date at which a player ability profile was captured.
scope: Selecting the correct player ability snapshot for a stated date or date range.

name: Player Height
definition: The recorded height of a player in centimetres.
scope: Physique comparison and tallest or shortest player questions.

name: Overall Rating
definition: A player's overall FIFA ability score on a 0-100 scale.
scope: Player ability comparison and averaging.

name: Finishing Score
definition: A player's FIFA finishing ability score on a 0-100 scale.
scope: Attacking skill comparison between players.

name: Volleys Score
definition: A player's FIFA volleys ability score on a 0-100 scale, held in a column whose name is plural.
scope: Skill filtering of players.

name: Dribbling Score
definition: A player's FIFA dribbling ability score on a 0-100 scale.
scope: Skill filtering of players.

name: Build-up Play Speed
definition: A numeric rating of how quickly a team moves the ball forward during build-up play.
scope: Team playing-style filtering and comparison.

name: Build-up Play Passing
definition: A numeric rating of a team's passing style during build-up play, ranging from short to long passing.
scope: Team playing-style filtering and comparison.

name: Home Team Goals
definition: The number of goals scored by the home team in a match.
scope: Match outcome and goal aggregation.
aliases: goals scored by the home team

name: Away Team Goals
definition: The number of goals scored by the away team in a match.
scope: Match outcome and goal aggregation.
aliases: goals scored by the away team

name: Total Match Goals
definition: The total number of goals scored in a match by both teams together.
scope: Goals-per-match and league goal aggregation.

name: Away Team Win
definition: An indicator of whether the away team won a match by scoring strictly more goals than the home team.
scope: Counting away wins per team, league or season.

name: Match Count
definition: The number of matches played in a league, season or stage.
scope: League ranking by number of matches.

name: Work Rate Level
definition: The shared ordinal scale of player work-rate tendency, running from low through medium to high.
scope: Interpreting any work-rate column value.

name: Attacking Work Rate
definition: A player's tendency to join attacking moves, expressed on the shared work-rate scale.
scope: Identifying attack-minded players.

name: Defensive Work Rate
definition: A player's tendency to hold position and defend while the team attacks, expressed on the shared work-rate scale.
scope: Identifying defensively disciplined players.
aliases: remain in his position and defense

name: Build-up Play Speed Class
definition: The categorical banding of build-up play speed into Slow, Balanced and Fast.
scope: Categorical team playing-style interpretation.

name: Chance Creation Passing Class
definition: The categorical banding of a team's chance-creation passing into Safe, Normal and Risky.
scope: Categorical team playing-style interpretation.
aliases: played safe while creating chance of passing
